# OpenUI Lang for render_ui

- One statement per line: `name = Component(arg1, arg2, ...)`. `root = Stack([...])` is required and is the entry point.
- Arguments are POSITIONAL in the order listed below (no `key: value`); optional ones may be left off the end.
- Values: "strings" (double quotes, \ escapes), numbers, true/false, null, [arrays], and references to other statements.
- Every statement except root must be reachable from root (put it in a parent's children array) or it is dropped.
- Keep a block small — a card, a chart, a short table or one form; it is one message in a chat, not a dashboard.
- Hebrew is fine anywhere (every component is RTL-safe). Button and Form submit send text back to you as the human's next message; a Form adds a ```json block of its field values.

## Components

Stack(children: any[], direction?: "column" | "row") — Vertical (default) or horizontal group of children
Card(title: string, children: any[]) — Bordered panel with a title
Text(text: string, tone?: "normal" | "muted" | "strong") — One line or paragraph of plain text
Markdown(text: string) — Markdown text (lists, links, code, bold)
Stat(label: string, value: string, delta?: string) — A headline number with a label and an optional change
Table(columns: string[], rows: (string | number | boolean | any)[][]) — Rows of cells under column headers
BarChart(labels: string[], values: number[], title?: string) — Bar chart, one series
LineChart(labels: string[], values: number[], title?: string) — Line chart over ordered labels, one series
Button(label: string, message: string, style?: "default" | "primary") — Sends `message` to the agent as the human's reply when pressed
Form(name: string, children: any[], submitLabel?: string, message?: string) — Groups inputs; submit sends `message` plus every field value to the agent
TextInput(name: string, label: string, placeholder?: string, defaultValue?: string) — Single-line text field inside a Form
Select(name: string, label: string, options: string[], defaultValue?: string) — Dropdown inside a Form
Checkbox(name: string, label: string, defaultChecked?: boolean) — Yes/no toggle inside a Form

## Examples

root = Stack([kpis, chart])
kpis = Stack([s1, s2], "row")
s1 = Stat("Visitors", "12,480", "+8%")
s2 = Stat("Sign-ups", "312", "-2%")
chart = BarChart(["Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri"], [120, 180, 150, 210, 240], "Sign-ups this week")

root = Stack([card])
card = Card("מה להזמין?", [form])
form = Form("order", [item, qty, rush], "שלח", "Order form submitted")
item = Select("item", "פריט", ["חלב", "לחם", "ביצים"])
qty = TextInput("qty", "כמות", "1")
rush = Checkbox("rush", "משלוח מהיר")
